idea-plugin.name: PureDown
idea-plugin.description:
PureDown - Modern Markdown & Obsidian-Grade Knowledge Workspace for IntelliJ IDEA & Android Studio

PureDown is a high-performance Markdown editing, rendering, and knowledge management plugin designed for modern technical writing and documentation:

  • Seamless In-Place Split Editor: High-performance bidirectional synchronized scrolling with 3 layout modes (Split Mode, Editor Only, Preview Only). Customizable default view mode in Settings.
  • Floating Formatting Toolbar: Format selections instantly (Bold, Italic, Strikethrough, Code, Quote, Links, Task lists).
  • Full-Featured CJK Table Formatter: In-place Markdown table alignment with CJK fullwidth support, automatic column padding, and quick template insertion.
  • Live Document Statistics Bar: Status bar showing cursor position (Ln, Col), character count, word count, line count, and estimated reading time.
  • Smart Task Lists & Ordered Lists: One-click interactive checkbox toggle (- [ ] ↔ - [x]) in both preview and editor, plus auto-renumbering of sequential lists.
  • Obsidian Vault & Knowledge Base Power:
    • [[WikiLinks]] resolution and auto-completion with Ctrl/Cmd+Click navigation.
    • Obsidian Callouts ([!NOTE], [!TIP], [!WARNING], [!DANGER], [!SUCCESS], etc.) rendered with styled colored badges and icons.
    • Interactive 2D Knowledge Vault Graph showing note connection nodes, physics layout, and search.
  • Rich Preview & Technical Writing Extensions: YAML Front Matter metadata cards, in-document [TOC] outline, offline KaTeX math formulas, Mermaid architecture diagrams, code copy buttons, and image click lightbox zoom.
  • Full Chinese & English Localization (i18n): UI, settings, actions, and preview components adapt to IDE language or can be manually selected.
  • Inspections & Quick Fixes: PSI inspections for skipped heading hierarchy, unaligned tables, and empty links.
  • Export & Clipboard: One-click Copy as Rendered HTML for publishing (WeChat, Zhihu, Notion) and Standalone HTML file export.
